departments.Sales: Seller and prospect calls, setter scripts, negotiation, lead management, appointment setting and closing. Use Sales for training on property tools when the main purpose is using them during sales calls.
departments.Marketing: Direct mail, LettrLabs campaigns and undeliverables, advertising, SEO, copywriting, websites, branding and promotional content.
departments.Acquisitions: Property analysis, comps, underwriting, valuation, GIS, offer calculations and due diligence. Use Acquisitions when analysis is the main purpose rather than sales conversation training.
departments.Operations: Internal administration, task management, utilities, property management and repeatable company processes.
departments.Construction: Renovation, scope of work, contractors, purchasing construction materials, jobsite walkthroughs and project management.
departments.Data & Automation: Data sourcing, courthouse research, data cleaning, lists, skip tracing, spreadsheet formulas, programming, integrations, n8n and automations.
departments.Finance: Invoices, bookkeeping, taxes, budgeting and payment procedures.
departments.People & Training: Hiring, employment, general employee onboarding, general training and people processes. Department-specific training belongs in that department.
departments.Personal: Wedding, family, sports leagues, hobbies and other nonbusiness recordings.
departments.unknown: Insufficient evidence, unclear main subject, or no suitable department. Do not guess from an autogenerated filename.

purposes.How-tos: A tutorial demonstrating how to accomplish a specific task.
purposes.SOPs: A standard operating procedure defining repeatable steps, rules, responsibilities or required checks.
purposes.Training: A broader lesson, skill development, educational presentation or onboarding. Specific task tutorials belong in How-tos.
purposes.Meetings: A recorded conversation, team sync, review meeting or interview.
purposes.Walkthroughs: A tour of a property, jobsite, scope of work or physical finished work.
purposes.Reference: A product demo, report, feedback, troubleshooting, bug report or other reference material.
purposes.unknown: Insufficient evidence to determine recording purpose.
